ai.title: Anthropic is burning gas to feed the AI boom
ai.brief: Anthropic is clear that data centers will run on gas, to the company’s own detriment. Anthropic is clear that data centers will run on gas, to the company’s own detriment. As it prepares to go public , Anthropic’s S-1 filing makes generative AI’s methane dependency glaringly obvious. ” In documents filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission Monday, Anthropic acknowledges that data centers are becoming increasingly reliant on “natural gas” — the fossil fuel industry’s marketing term for what is primarily methane — leaving the company’s AI data center buildout vulnerable to rising fuel costs and existing supply chain constraints. And in a possible catch-22, Anthropic admits that rising global temperatures — a symptom of burning fossil fuels — will increase the company’s operating costs.

sec.title: Magento Campaign Infects 953 Online Stores Across Five Domains
sec.brief: S. S. CISA adds Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog A criminal group has infected 953 online stores since July 2025, mostly Magento shops, according to Sansec researchers. The attackers add a small piece of code to store pages. When someone visits a shop, their browser contacts the attackers’ server to get further instructions. The server checks whether the visitor is a real shopper or a security scanner. If it detects a scanner, it hides the malicious activity. com is the newest web address of a criminal group that breaks into online stores. ” Sansec’s analysis states. “The group has done this to 953 stores since July 2025, mostly Magento shops. ”
